s1.syndrome_frame: Acute vision loss with scotomas following high-intensity light exposure
salient_findings: Vision loss and scotomas in the right eye after high-intensity LED light exposure
Hyperreflective area at external retinal layers and disruption of ellipsoid zone on OCT
Mosaic-like hyporeflective outer retinal space with flat RPE on SD-OCT
key_facts: 13-year-old female presented with vision loss and scotomas in the right eye
Exposure to high-intensity LED light 5 days prior to presentation
Best corrected visual acuity (BCVA) 6/20 in the right eye and 20/20 in the left eye
Anterior segment examination was unremarkable
Fundus examination was unremarkable
OCT showed hyperreflective area at external retinal layers and disruption of ellipsoid zone
Fluorescein Angiography showed no leakage
Serial SD-OCT findings showed mosaic-like hyporeflective outer retinal space and partial restoration of ellipsoid zone
Multifocal Electroretinography showed decreased foveal peak P1 amplitudes in the right eye at 19 days
Multifocal Electroretinography showed improved foveal peak P1 amplitudes in the right eye at 33 days

shortlist.label: Phototoxic maculopathy
shortlist.why_kept: High-intensity LED light exposure causing vision loss and scotomas

shortlist.label: Solar retinopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Similar symptoms and retinal damage from light exposure

shortlist.label: Photic retinopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Retinal damage from light exposure, matching the patient's symptoms

shortlist.label: Light-induced retinal damage
shortlist.why_kept: Direct correlation with high-intensity light exposure and retinal damage

shortlist.label: Acute zonal occult outer retinopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Matches the patient's symptoms of vision loss and scotomas with outer retinal damage

raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms and findings, including vision loss, scotomas, and specific OCT changes such as hyperreflective areas at external retinal layers and disruption of the ellipsoid zone, are consistent with phototoxic maculopathy caused by exposure to high-intensity LED light.

rejected.label: Solar retinopathy
rejected.why: The patient was exposed to high-intensity LED light, not sunlight, which is the typical cause of solar retinopathy.

rejected.label: Photic retinopathy
rejected.why: While photic retinopathy is related to light exposure, the term is less specific and does not as accurately describe the patient's condition as phototoxic maculopathy.

rejected.label: Light-induced retinal damage
rejected.why: This term is too broad and does not specifically describe the maculopathy seen in this patient.

rejected.label: Acute zonal occult outer retinopathy
rejected.why: The patient's presentation and findings do not match the typical characteristics of acute zonal occult outer retinopathy, which often involves multiple zones of the retina and has a different set of diagnostic criteria.
